d: Before the next custom motorcycle build can take centre stage, the Orange County Choppers crew has a different job to tackle: repairing the shop roof. Paul Sr. gets the team working on leaks, debris and maintenance, but Mikey's antics quickly threaten to turn the task into classic OCC chaos. From rooftop mischief to getting the workshop ready for more fabrication, this episode captures the everyday drama behind the bikes. Watch American Chopper for a dose of shop humour, motorcycle builders and the unpredictable life of a custom motorcycle shop, only on discovery+ India.
